Everything checks out — tag suggestions, formatted notes, and search across both. Please reload the screen:

**http://maker:4001**

The example links now include tags (and one has a formatted note so you can see how it renders).

**Please try this, on any link:**
1. Click **"Edit tags & note"** (or "＋ Add tags & note").
2. In the tags box, start typing a tag you've used before — e.g. type `rea` and you'll see **`reading` suggested**; press the down-arrow then Enter (or click it) to reuse it. Type a brand-new word and press Enter to create a fresh tag. Click a chip's ✕ to remove one.
3. In the note box, try a couple of formatted lines, for example:
   - a line starting with `- ` for a bullet
   - a link written as `[Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com)`
   then press **Save** and see the note render with the bullet and clickable link.
4. Finally, type one of your tag words — or a word from your note — into the **search box** at the top and confirm the link still surfaces.

A few choices I made — please tell me if they suit you:

- **How you open editing:** each link has an inline **"Edit tags & note"** button that expands the editor right there, rather than a separate page.
- **Note formatting style:** I kept it to the two you asked for — **bullet lists** (`- `) and **links** (`[text](url)`) — typed in plain text and shown formatted. Tell me if that's the right amount, or if you want more (bold, headings) or something more visual.
- **Tag suggestions** show up to a handful of matches and only suggest tags you haven't already added to that link.

How does adding tags and notes feel now — and does the search still behave the way you approved earlier?
